We have mass spectrum data. Need to identify elements definitively based on isotope distribution patterns visible. Look at peaks: m/z values around 232-240. Likely isotopic pattern of chlorine? Cl has 35Cl (34.969) and 37Cl (36.966) difference ~2. But here peaks spaced ~1? Actually peaks: 231.96544, 232.96883 (+1.00339), 233.96320 (+0.9946), 234.96657 (+1.00337), 235.96061 (+0.99404), 236.96388 (+1.00327), 237.96725 (+1.00337), 238.97064 (+1.00339), 239.97406 (+1.00342). This pattern of ~1 Da spacing suggests isotopic pattern of a molecule with many C/H? But we need identify elements based on isotopic patterns: e.g., presence of chlorine/bromine gives characteristic 2:1 ratio peaks separated by 2 Da. Not seen. Sulfur has 32S, 33S, 34S, 36S with small intensities. But pattern? Not obvious.

We can retrieve isotopic distribution of elements to compare.
